title: #321 Hurry in Life
prompt: Some people are always in a hurry to go to various places and get things done. Other people prefer to take their time and live a life at a slower pace. What is your opinion?

promptSegments.text: Some people are always in a hurry to go to various places and get things done.
Other people prefer to take their time and live a life at a slower pace.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu rõ mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Bảo vệ quan điểm bằng 2 lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Sử dụng các dẫn chứng thực tế thuyết phục để củng cố luận điểm.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: A fast life helps people achieve their goals.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A fast life helps people achieve their goals.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A busy life helps people feel successful.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A busy life helps people feel successful.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: A slow pace of life is beneficial, countering the idea that people must hurry.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A slow pace of life is beneficial, countering the idea that people must hurry.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay provides two reasons: better physical/mental health and stronger personal relationships.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay provides two reasons: better physical/mental health and stronger personal relationships.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The pressure to achieve many things and the demands of modern life make a fast pace necessary.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The pressure to achieve many things and the demands of modern life make a fast pace necessary.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Examples like students rushing projects and people using phones for work to support the idea of constant activity.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Examples like students rushing projects and people using phones for work to support the idea of constant activity.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: A slower pace of life is better than constantly rushing.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A slower pace of life is better than constantly rushing.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay discusses how a slower pace improves mental health and strengthens social bonds.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay discusses how a slower pace improves mental health and strengthens social bonds.

promptTraps.en: Do not answer only the first question while neglecting the second requirement; address both dimensions equally.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ trả lời câu hỏi đầu tiên mà bỏ quên yêu cầu thứ hai; cần giải quyết cả hai khía cạnh công bằng.

promptTraps.en: Do not merely rephrase the topic without stating a definitive personal position in both intro and conclusion.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ diễn đạt lại đề bài mà quên khẳng định rõ lập trường cá nhân ở cả mở bài và kết bài.

faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
